title: Mountain Bike, card B: the leaf meadow
kaylee: The green trail opens into two wide meadows of fallen leaves: big S-turns, a dark groove behind her wheel, leaves puffing up on every flip, and the hare and the deer jumping out of her way.
questions: Do the meadows feel like Bottomless (yes, closer, or no)?
Is the hare and deer jumping away fun (yes or no)?
